name: Electronic Publication
engine: EPUB 2 / 3 Spine Pagination & Scroll Engine v2
details: Full support for EPUB 2 and 3 standards. Includes interactive table of contents, pagination, continuous vertical scroll, chapter progress, and responsive typography.
limitations: DRM-protected (encrypted) files are rejected. Adobe Adept and proprietary container protections are not circumvented.

name: Portable Document Format
details: Integrated offline PDF viewer with crisp page rendering, zoom controls, fit-to-width, jump-to-page, and reading position remembrance.
limitations: Encrypted or password-protected PDF files must be decrypted prior to reading.

name: Mobipocket / Kindle
details: Unpacks uncompressed PalmDOC and KF8 container records, extracting formatted chapter text and embedded cover art.
limitations: Kindle KFX format and Amazon DRM-protected books are not supported.

name: FictionBook 2
engine: XML Parser with DOMPurify XSS Sanitization
details: Parses FictionBook XML markup, cover images, chapter hierarchy, epigraphs, and footnotes with strict XSS sanitization.
limitations: Malformatted XML tags are repaired automatically; corrupt binary payloads are ignored.

name: Zipped FictionBook 2
details: Decompresses zip-contained FictionBook documents and renders the internal FB2 payload safely.
limitations: Zip-bomb bounds check enforced (max 512 MB decompressed ratio).

name: Microsoft Word Document
details: Extracts document body paragraphs, heading hierarchies, tables, bold/italic formatting, and clean typography.
limitations: Complex Word macros, OLE embedded objects, and tracked change markups are stripped for clean reading.

name: Legacy Microsoft Word
details: Reads stream records from legacy binary Word 97-2003 documents and extracts readable text paragraphs.
limitations: Complex legacy binary drawing objects and equations may not retain exact desktop Word pagination.

name: OpenDocument Text
details: Unpacks standard ODF ZIP packages, parsing content.xml styles, headings, lists, and formatted paragraphs.
limitations: Complex frame drawings or macros are safely omitted.

name: Rich Text Format
details: Parses RTF control words, font tables, character encodings, bold, italics, alignment, and unicode escapes.
limitations: Embedded binary OLE payloads and executable RTF exploits are permanently neutralized.

name: Plain Text Document
details: Auto-detects UTF-8, UTF-16, and ASCII encodings. Renders with comfortable margins, line wrapping, and reader theme customization.
limitations: Plain text contains no inherent chapter metadata or embedded images.

name: Markdown Document
details: Renders CommonMark markdown, code blocks, tables, lists, task lists, and blockquotes with full styling and theme support.
limitations: Inline raw script execution is strictly disabled.

name: Hypertext Document
details: Loads local single-file HTML or packaged web documents with CSS stylesheets and imagery.
limitations: External scripts, tracking beacons, and remote network calls are blocked by strict Content Security Policy.

name: Comic Book Archive (ZIP)
details: Extracts high-resolution JPG, PNG, WEBP, and AVIF image pages in sorted natural order. Supports fit-to-screen and navigation.
limitations: Requires standard image files inside archive; archives without images are gracefully reported.

name: Comic Book Archive (RAR)
details: Extracts RAR-compressed comic archives and renders sequential high-resolution pages.
limitations: Encrypted or password-protected RAR archives cannot be unpacked.

name: Comic Book Archive (7z)
details: Supports LZMA and LZMA2 compressed 7z comic archives with high compression ratio decompression.
limitations: Multi-volume split archives (.7z.001) must be joined before reading.

name: Compiled HTML Help
details: Decompresses Microsoft Compiled HTML Help (ITSF) archives, extracting the table of contents and HTML topics.
limitations: ActiveX controls and legacy IE-specific scripts inside old CHM files are sanitized and ignored.

name: DjVu Document
details: Renders high-compression layered scanned pages, separate text layers, and monochrome background/foreground bitonal bitmaps.
limitations: Rare proprietary JB2 compression extensions may fall back to document text layer.
